'''Grand Master''' was a title used in both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old]] and [[New Jedi Order|New]] Jedi Orders to describe the recognized head of the Order. While separate from the title [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]], which was used to describe the elected leader of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the positions were often filled by the same person.

==History==
<!-- ODAN-URR HAS NOT BEEN CONFIRMED AS A GRAND MASTER. ADDING THEM HERE IS VIEWED AS FANON, AND THIS IS YOUR ONLY WARNING IF YOU CHOSE TO ADD THAT INFORMATION HERE. -->
{{Quote|For a renowned Grand Master, you do seem to worry a lot''"<br />"''If an old Jedi ''you'' wish to be, worry a lot ''you'' will!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Yoda|<ref name="Guns of Nar Hekka">{{TCWComicCite|6.13|The Guns of Nar Hekka}}</ref>}}
The title of Grand Master had existed within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for much of its history, representing the elected head of the entire Order. The appointment of a Grand Master was reserved to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], with a unanimous vote needed to install the Order's leader. Bestowed only upon the Order's greatest and wisest of all [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]], it was not unheard of for several Masters to hold the title, forming elite guilds before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TJP" /> The responsibility typically held for life or until the person with title relinquishes it to other. The Grand Master represents Jedi Council's will and intentions, when interacting with the Republic's politicians and millitary leaders. They are also decision makers within the Jedi High Council itself, rendering final judgement when the other members are evenly divided on an issue. The Grand Master offers guidance and leadership to all who follow the Jedi path.<ref name="TORENCY">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Held by several Masters throughout the Order's history, the earliest known Grand Master was [[Awdrysta Pina]], who was Grand Master<ref name="Force">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> by [[24,500 BBY]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> [[Biel Ductavis]] was appointed Grand Master in [[10,966 BBY]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Zym]], who was the Grand Master throughout the [[Great Galactic War]], was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] shortly after the [[Sacking of Coruscant|fall]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Threat of Peace Act 2" /> Sometime later, [[Satele Shan]] was elected as Grand Master, becoming the youngest known individual to ever receive the title.<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> Several millennia later, Master [[Fae Coven]] held the title, leading reforms within the Order as it moved away from its militant position it held throughout the [[Old Sith Wars|Old]] and [[New Sith Wars|New]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Wars. During the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic|Republic's Golden Age]], Coven authored the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]], ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', with the help of some of the leading Masters of the era. Master Coven served a long term, even meeting her eventual successor, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="TJP" /> Master Yoda was the last Grand Master of the Old Jedi Order, holding the title as early as [[82 BBY/Legends|82 BBY]].<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous" /> Under Yoda, the Order was disbanded as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Declaration of a New Order|returned]] to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|power]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> and ushered in a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]<ref name="New Order">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> which saw the initiation of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="ROTS" />

Before his death, the exiled Master Yoda helped [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] complete his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a Jedi; Skywalker would eventually [[New Jedi Order|rebuild]] the Order and [[Conclave on Ossus|declare]] himself Grand Master during the [[Swarm War]] of [[36 ABY]].<ref name="The Swarm War" /> Leading the Order he had built for many years, Skywalker was held responsible for the [[Second Galactic Civil War|actions]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-Sith [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] government. After trying the Grand Master, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Skywalker from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the Jedi Order in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] until he could prove what had caused Solo's turn to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. In the meantime, Skywalker and Daala agreed to the appointment of Master [[Kenth Hamner]] as acting Grand Master, until Skywalker returned or the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|High Council]] elected another Master.<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref><ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>

When tensions between Daala's Galactic Alliance and the Jedi Order grew, the Jedi refused to continue appeasing her demands of the Order. The Masters wanted to launch a wing of [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to help Skywalker fight a new Sith [[Lost Tribe of Sith|threat]], but Hamner feared that the Galactic Alliance would think the launch was against them and would open fire on the StealthXs. However, when the Council discovered that Hamner had taken unilateral actions in making an agreement with Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] to stall the launch until Bwua'tu gave him permission, they removed him from his position as acting Grand Master and decided to launch the wing, forming a [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge|plan]] with [[Booster Terrik]] to keep the starfighters safe. Hamner attempted to stop the StealthX launch, and in the ensuing [[Skirmish in the Operations Hangar|skirmish]] with Master [[Saba Sebatyne]], he fell to his [[Death/Legends|death]]. The Masters then unanimously voted for Sebatyne, who had led the vote of no confidence against Hamner, as the new acting Grand Master. She felt that the appointment was wrong, as she was deeply upset over her failure to prevent Hamner's death, but eventually accepted the position.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

Following a Jedi [[Plan Delta|coup]] that removed Daala from power and placed the Jedi in charge of the government, Skywalker's sentence was revoked, allowing him to resume his position as Grand Master. He did not return to Coruscant immediately, however, instead staying on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] to [[Operation Shieldfall|defeat]] the dark side entity [[Abeloth]], who was his primary concern for the moment.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> Skywalker eventually returned to Coruscant and convinced the Jedi to leave the planet in order to lure the Sith out.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Yoda was first given the title of "Grand Master of the Jedi Order" in ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''. In the novel, Yoda was also referred to as "Master of the Order" at one point, implying that it was simply an alternate name for the title. However, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later established Master of the Order as a separate position from Grand Master, and stated that the position was normally held by Mace Windu, with Yoda only temporarily assuming the role when Windu was off-world.
